restriction: Retains formal clauses (i)-(iii), the multivalued-support and fitted-zero counterexamples, and the rare-overlap positivity and arbitrarily-small-effective-mass family for every 0 < epsilon < 1/2. Estimator unbiasedness, moments, deviation bounds, and consistency are asserted only at epsilon = 1/1000000, rather than jointly with arbitrarily small effective-profile mass. Omits the empirical Jensen country-contribution assertion.
